tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background for the era in view. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Event cards, the filter drawer and the year HUD panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, card titles and the year HUD, on ground, ground-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, region/theme tags, source lines — on ground and ground-raised.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the timeline spine, card borders, dividers. Decorative only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The era's identity colour: era chapter headings, links, active filter, the spine's progress fill. As text on ground or ground-raised.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: a highlighted card, the era chapter banner, the verdict stamp ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an accent fill (active filter chip, primary button).

tokens.name: react-panic
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Panic (the burst). Mark only; the label beside it stays ink.

tokens.name: react-concern
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Credible concern (the triangle). Mark only.

tokens.name: react-wonder
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Wonder (the star). Mark only.

tokens.name: react-hope
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Optimism (the rising sun). Mark only.

tokens.name: react-cooperation
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Cooperation (two joined rings). Mark only.

tokens.name: react-celebration
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Celebration (the raised glass). Mark only.

tokens.name: react-humour
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Humour (the grin). Mark only.

tokens.name: react-complacency
tokens.usage: ReactionMark fill for Complacency (the flat bar). Mark only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. Aliases ink, so it holds 3:1+ on every ground in every era.

tokens.name: era-antiquity
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Antiquity segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-medieval
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Medieval segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-print
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Print Age segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-industrial
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Industrial segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-machine
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Machine Age segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-atomic
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Atomic segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-analog
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Analog segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: era-digital
tokens.usage: Constant across themes: the Digital segment of the timeline minimap and era jump menu. Fill only, never text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Event card body copy and chapter intros. Constant in every era.
styles.sample: Crowds gathered on hilltops and some built arks.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Source lines, footnotes, the 'what happened next' line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Region and theme tags, filter chips, verdict stamp text. Uppercase.

styles.name: year-hud
styles.usage: The persistent year counter. Its skin changes per era via bundle.css; the size does not.

styles.name: display-antiquity
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Antiquity is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-medieval
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Medieval is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-print
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Print Age is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-industrial
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Industrial is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-machine
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Machine Age is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-atomic
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Atomic is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-analog
styles.usage: Card titles and chapter headings while Analog is in view. Card titles run at 28px/32px; chapter headings at 64px/68px.

styles.name: display-digital

tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag gaps, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gap between rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a card and the spine.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on the timeline.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Chapter heading clearance.

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Antiquity, Medieval, Print Age, Industrial cards — carved, cut and printed edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Digital cards and every era's tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Machine Age cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the verdict stamp in every era.
